text_block_list.text: Another day of training with El Condor Pasa had come to an end.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! Well then!
El is going to go work up another sweat, desu!
choice_data_list: Ready to work up another sweat?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Sí!
I was just thinking of doing some voluntary training, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Papa used to tell me. The most important thing to getting stronger is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: To always continue choosing the harder path for myself.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That is why El must work even harder!
choice_data_list: I'll match that passion every step of the way!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That is why El must work even harder!
choice_data_list: I'll match that passion every step of the way!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Is that true?! I knew it, the same passionate blood flows through you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us burn with passion together
toward that crimson setting sun, de~su!

Afterward, El Condor Pasa and I
devoted ourselves to extra training
until the sun went down.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ehh~, El doesn't want to rest, no way!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I want to spend even more time
on training and get faster, yes!
choice_data_list: Isn't it painful to just rest?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
That... might be true, but desu.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
If El must choose the harder path, then El will...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Understood!
I will take a rest!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: This is also something necessary for El to take flight into the world, yes!
